# Manus Unified Asset & Cleanup Manifest — Phase 1 + Phase 2

**Scope.** This is an archival reconciliation of only assets created or handled by Manus under the `EXT-*` and `MANUS-P2-*` naming conventions. It performs **no browser action, no retry and no deletion**. A status is a record of the last evidenced state, not a claim about current server state.

> **Status vocabulary.** `CLEANED_CONFIRMED` means a recorded normal-UI delete success. `CLEANUP_BLOCKED` means normal UI did not yield a safe completed delete confirmation, so deletion was stopped. `UNCONFIRMED_CLEANUP` means a cleanup attempt or follow-up could not be verified. `LOCAL_FIXTURE_RETAINED` is not a platform object.

## Reconciliation and handoff notes

All known Manus-created remote test objects now have an explicit archival state. `CLEANUP_BLOCKED` and `UNCONFIRMED_CLEANUP` must **not** be collapsed to `CLEANED` in any later summary. Before any future manual cleanup, the operator should separately re-authenticate the appropriate owner, inspect only the exact named test asset, and capture fresh confirmation; this archive does not authorize or request a retry.

The authoritative Phase 2 per-object detail remains `worldos_p2_evidence/MANUS_P2_CLEANUP_MANIFEST.md`. This unified document adds the Phase 1 `EXT-*` record and local fixtures for an all-assets merge view.
